hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$today = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); $notePath = \"06 Daily Notes/$today.md\"; if (-not (Test-Path $notePath)) { $template = Get-Content '05 Templates/Daily-Note-Template.md' -Raw; $content = $template -replace '\{\{date\}\}', $today; Set-Content -Path $notePath -Value $content -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host \"Daily Note erstellt: $today\" }"
